32664-black-amazon-of-mars.title: Black Amazon Of Mars
32664-black-amazon-of-mars.creator: Unknown
32664-black-amazon-of-mars.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. near them but for Camar. They were wrong, somehow, with a taint of forgotten evil still about them. The big Earthman glanced at Camar, and his face was sad. "A man likes to die in his own place," he said abruptly. "I am sorry."  "The Lord of Silence is a great personage," Camar answered. "He does not mind the meeting place. It was not for that I came back into the Norlands."  He was shaken by an agony that was not of the body.

arxiv-2106-08287.title: A series approximation to the Kirchhoff integral for Gaussian and exponential roughness covariance functions
arxiv-2106-08287.creator: Derek R. Olson
arxiv-2106-08287.description: Abstract The Kirchhoff integral is a fundamental integral in scattering theory, appearing in both the Kirchhoff approximation, as well as the small slope approximation. In this work, a functional Taylor series approximation to the-eps-converted-to.pdf Kirchhoff integral is presented, under the condition that the roughness covariance function follows either an exponential or Gaussian form–in both the one-dimensional and two-dimensional cases.

arxiv-2206-12412.title: Dynamic Propagation of Mode III Cracks in a Lattice Boltzmann Method for Solids
arxiv-2206-12412.creator: Henning Müller, Ali Touil, Alexander Schlüter, Ralf Müller, [8pt] Institute for Mechanics, Continuum Mechanics Group, Technische Universität Darmstadt, Germany
arxiv-2206-12412.description: Abstract This work presents concepts and algorithms for the simulation of dynamic fractures with a Lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) for linear elastic solids. This LBM has been presented previously and solves the wave equation, which is interpreted as the governing equation for antiplane shear deformation.

arxiv-2501-02790.title: Segmenting Text and Learning Their Rewards for Improved RLHF in Language Model
arxiv-2501-02790.creator: Yueqin Yin, Shentao Yang, Yujia Xie, Ziyi Yang, Yuting Sun, Hany Awadalla, Weizhu Chen, Mingyuan Zhou
arxiv-2501-02790.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has been widely adopted to align language models (LMs) with human preference. Prior RLHF works typically take a bandit formulation, which, though intuitive, ignores the sequential nature of LM generation and can suffer from the sparse reward issue.

arxiv-2506-21088.title: Nonsymmorphic symmetry-enforced hourglass fermions and Rashba-Dresselhaus interaction in BiInO 3
arxiv-2506-21088.creator: Ramsamoj Kewat, Nirmal Ganguli
arxiv-2506-21088.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate the spin texture of the hourglass fermions band network in BiInO 3 using density functional theory (DFT) and symmetry analysis. Hourglass fermions are of interest in spintronics due to their unique and robust band structure, as well as their potential applications in novel electronic devices.

arxiv-2512-05904.title: Transverse envelope dynamics of beam slices in a uniform charged ellipsoidal model of the plasma bubble regime
arxiv-2512-05904.creator: Abdul Mannan 1,2, Alessio Del Dotto 1, and Massimo Ferrario 1
arxiv-2512-05904.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Abdul Mannan 1,2, Alessio Del Dotto 1, and Massimo Ferrario 1. We consider a pair of driver/witness electron bunches propagating in an ionized gas background a configuration similar to the one produced in a capillary discharge where a plasma oscillation has been excited by a driving pulse. We assume as in the plasma nonlinear regime that the plasma electrons behind the driver are completely expelled and an ellipsoidal cavity filled with ions only is formed.

pmc-10594879.title: Children oral health and parents education status: a cross sectional study
pmc-10594879.creator: Giuseppe Minervini, Rocco Franco, Maria Maddalena Marrapodi, Marco Di Blasio, Vincenzo Ronsivalle, Marco Cicciù
pmc-10594879.description: Introduction Oral diseases are common and affect millions of people worldwide. They can range from mild and easily treatable conditions to more severe and serious diseases. Proper oral hygiene and regular dental monitoring are essential for maintaining good oral health. When it comes to children’s health and well-being, parents’ education level plays a critical role.

pmc-11431296.title: Substrate-Mediated Regulation of Src Expression Drives Osteoclastogenesis Divergence
pmc-11431296.creator: Bo Hu, Yiming Chen, Yuman Li, Chenyu Deng, Yuting Niu, Zhewen Hu, Yao Li, Shiyu Sun, Ying Huang, Xuliang Deng, Yan Wei, Stefano Lonardi, Piero Fariselli
pmc-11431296.description: Background/Objectives: Glass, bone, and dentin are commonly applied substrates for osteoclast cultures; however, the impact of these substrates on osteoclastogenesis remains underexplored. This study aimed to address a significant gap in understanding how different substrates influence the process of osteoclastogenesis. Methods: RAW 264.7 cells were cultured and induced with RANKL on glass, bone, and dentin slides.

pmc-11524921.title: Exploring the most discriminative brain structural abnormalities in ASD with multi-stage progressive feature refinement approach
pmc-11524921.creator: Bingxi Sun, Yingying Xu, Siuching Kat, Anlan Sun, Tingni Yin, Liyang Zhao, Xing Su, Jialu Chen, Hui Wang, Xiaoyun Gong, Qinyi Liu, Gangqiang Han, Shuchen Peng, Xue Li, Jing Liu
pmc-11524921.description: ObjectiveAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by increasing prevalence, diverse impairments, and unclear origins and mechanisms. To gain a better grasp of the origins of ASD, it is essential to identify the most distinctive structural brain abnormalities in individuals with ASD.

pmc-11651915.title: Small molecule protein assembly modulators with pan-cancer therapeutic efficacy
pmc-11651915.creator: Anuradha F. Lingappa, Olayemi Akintunde, Erin Samueli, Connie Ewald, Maya Michon, Niloufar Ziari, Ming Lu, Shao Feng Yu, Markus Froehlich, Phuong Uyen Le, Yuniel Fernandez, Suguna Mallesh, Jim Lin, Anatoliy Kitaygorodskyy, Dennis Solas, Jonathan C. Reed, Jaisri R. Lingappa, Andreas Müller-Schiffmann
pmc-11651915.description: Two structurally unrelated small molecule chemotypes, represented by compounds PAV-617 and PAV-951, with antiviral activity in cell culture against Mpox virus (formerly known as monkeypox virus) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) respectively, were studied for anti-cancer efficacy. Each exhibited apparent pan-cancer cytotoxicity with reasonable pharmacokinetics.

pmc-11690682.title: AMBIGUOUS LOSS AND RESILIENCE IN THE FAMILY CONTEXT OF DEMENTIA: A META-SYNTHESIS
pmc-11690682.creator: Athena Chung Yin Chan, Cade Perkins, Lizbeth Garcia, Sophia Lyons, Frank Hernandez, Jonathan Singer
pmc-11690682.description: Having family members living with Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias (ADRDs) triggers high distress due to ambiguous loss. Ambiguous loss is an unclear loss with no resolution or closure to the physical presence and psychological absence of a loved family member. Resilience may buffer the distress from ambiguous loss in the family context of ADRDs.

pmc-11710599.title: Examining Practice Effects at Multiple Retest Intervals in Older Adults at Risk for Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-11710599.creator: Hannah M Wilks, Matthew S Welhaf, Andrew J Aschenbrenner, Carlos Cruchaga, John C Morris, Jason J Hassenstab
pmc-11710599.description: BackgroundPractice effects (PEs) on cognitive tests are improvements in performance from repeated testing. We and others have shown that reductions in PEs on standard tests administered annually are associated with neurodegenerative disease. Using mobile technology, cognition can be assessed at much higher frequencies than standard in‐clinic assessments.

pmc-13070363.title: Giant epidermoid cyst of the floor of mouth masquerading as a foregut duplication cyst: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-13070363.creator: Satnam S Rehal, Andre Alleyne, Hany Hashesh, Sundarraj Lakshmiah
pmc-13070363.description: Epidermoid cysts are benign lesions composed of an epithelial lining filled with keratinous debris. The absence of skin appendages distinguishes them from true dermoid cysts. While they may occur in various anatomical locations, they rarely exceed the 5-cm threshold used to define ‘giant’ lesions.

pmc-13604555.title: Associations Between FTO (Fat Mass- and Obesity-Associated) Gene Allelic Load and Heart Rate Responses to Submaximal Exercise in Humans: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13604555.creator: Habib Al Ashkar, Nora Kovacs, Karoly Nagy, Roza Adany, Peter Piko
pmc-13604555.description: Simple SummaryPeople differ in how their heart responds to physical exertion. In this study, we explored whether common variations in the FTO gene, widely known for its role in body weight regulation, are associated with heart rate responses during and after a standardized submaximal step test in a population-based cohort of 660 adults.

uslaw-usc-t14-s909.title: 14 U.S.C. § 909 — Small boat station rescue capability
uslaw-usc-t14-s909.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s909.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 9 (Administration); Subchapter I (Real And Personal Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall ensure that each Coast Guard small boat station (including a seasonally operated station) maintains, within the area of responsibility for the station, at least 1 vessel that is fully capable of performing offshore rescue operations, taking into consideration.
